crossRefs.note: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

translations.web: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
translations.bsb: God called the expanse “sky.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.
translations.kjv: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.
translations.asv: And God called the firmament Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.
